rollout_brier_improvement_min_frac.title: Rollout Brier Improvement Min Frac

run_stability.description: If True, run stability analysis on discovery DMPs after the main loop (gene stability only if enricher ran).

samples_base_path.description: Base directory for resolving sample names from CSVs (same as project samples_base_path).

stability_convergence_jaccard.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity required between current and lagged stable DMP panels.
stability_convergence_jaccard.title: Stability Convergence Jaccard

stability_convergence_max_size_delta.description: Maximum allowed relative panel-size change between current and lagged stable DMP panels.
stability_convergence_max_size_delta.title: Stability Convergence Max Size Delta

stability_convergence_patience.description: Number of consecutive convergence checkpoints that must pass before stopping early.
stability_convergence_patience.title: Stability Convergence Patience

stability_convergence_window.description: Window size (in qualifying runs) for comparing stable panels S_k vs S_(k-window).
stability_convergence_window.title: Stability Convergence Window

stability_default_freeze_tier.description: Tier whose stable_dmps_production.csv is aliased to root stability/stable_dmps_production.csv for default --freeze behavior.
stability_default_freeze_tier.title: Stability Default Freeze Tier

stability_dmp_freq.description: Minimum frequency (across runs) for a DMP to be considered stable.
stability_dmp_freq.title: Stability Dmp Freq

stability_dual_cutoff_enabled.description: If true, stability outputs both strict and relaxed stable DMP panels using score = effect_size * sqrt(frequency) with log-score elbow cutoff.
stability_dual_cutoff_enabled.title: Stability Dual Cutoff Enabled

stability_early_stop_enabled.description: If true, evaluate convergence of stable DMP panels during the MC loop and stop early when convergence thresholds hold for the configured patience.
stability_early_stop_enabled.title: Stability Early Stop Enabled

stability_featurecuts_enabled.description: If true, MC detector runs force classifier_dmp_selection=featurecuts_validation so stability can be computed from discriminatory classifier panels.
stability_featurecuts_enabled.title: Stability Featurecuts Enabled

stability_gene_featurecuts_enabled.description: If true, each MC iteration runs methyl-mapper then gene FeatureCuts (ECDF OvR k-search) after detector, and stability aggregates stable genes from genes-classifier exports.
stability_gene_featurecuts_enabled.title: Stability Gene Featurecuts Enabled

stability_gene_freq.description: Minimum frequency for a gene to be considered stable. When stability_gene_featurecuts_enabled, counts genes from per-run classifier gene panels.
stability_gene_freq.title: Stability Gene Freq

stability_min_balanced_accuracy.description: If set, stability counts DMPs only from iterations whose validation_metrics.json balanced_accuracy is >= this value. Frequencies are over those qualifying runs only.
stability_min_balanced_accuracy.title: Stability Min Balanced Accuracy

stability_min_iterations.description: Minimum number of qualifying runs required before stability convergence checks can trigger.
stability_min_iterations.title: Stability Min Iterations

stability_min_selected_dmps.description: Optional lower bound for detector classifier panel size in FeatureCuts mode. Final selected k is max(featurecuts_k, stability_min_selected_dmps).
stability_min_selected_dmps.title: Stability Min Selected Dmps

stability_min_selected_genes.description: Optional lower bound for gene classifier panel size in gene FeatureCuts mode. Final selected k is max(featurecuts_k, stability_min_selected_genes).
stability_min_selected_genes.title: Stability Min Selected Genes

stability_relaxed_cutoff_mode.description: How to derive relaxed stability cutoff when dual-cutoff is enabled: elbow_log_score (second elbow in tail) or strict_multiplier.
stability_relaxed_cutoff_mode.title: Stability Relaxed Cutoff Mode

stability_relaxed_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to strict score threshold when stability_relaxed_cutoff_mode='strict_multiplier'.
stability_relaxed_multiplier.title: Stability Relaxed Multiplier

stability_score_eps.description: Small epsilon used in log(score + eps) elbow detection.
stability_score_eps.title: Stability Score Eps

stability_target_balanced_accuracy.description: Optional target BA for detector FeatureCuts: choose minimum top-k DMPs that reach this BA on detector validation splits.
stability_target_balanced_accuracy.title: Stability Target Balanced Accuracy

stability_tier_core_freq.description: Core tier threshold for frequency-based stability.
stability_tier_core_freq.title: Stability Tier Core Freq

stability_tier_exploratory_freq.description: Exploratory tier threshold for frequency-based stability.
stability_tier_exploratory_freq.title: Stability Tier Exploratory Freq

stability_tier_extended_freq.description: Extended tier threshold for frequency-based stability.
stability_tier_extended_freq.title: Stability Tier Extended Freq

stability_tiers_enabled.description: If true, write three tiered stability outputs under stability/tier_core, stability/tier_extended, stability/tier_exploratory.
stability_tiers_enabled.title: Stability Tiers Enabled

subgroup_columns.description: Optional metadata columns for subgroup reporting in clinical performance reports (e.g., sex, age_bin, site_id, race_ethnicity).
subgroup_columns.title: Subgroup Columns

tabular_max_dmps.description: For model_backend=tabular_sklearn: optional cap on number of loci selected from bundle index. Set null or 0 to keep all stable DMPs.
tabular_max_dmps.title: Tabular Max Dmps

tabular_method_selection_metric.description: When multiple tabular_methods are evaluated sequentially, select best method using this metric from validation_metrics.
tabular_method_selection_metric.title: Tabular Method Selection Metric

tabular_method_selection_stat.description: Selection stat label for method ranking metadata (mean|median). Current per-run selection uses direct metric values.
tabular_method_selection_stat.title: Tabular Method Selection Stat

tabular_methods.description: Optional ordered list of tabular methods with method-specific parameters. When absent, synthesized from tabular_model_type for backward compatibility.
tabular_methods.title: Tabular Methods

tabular_model_type.description: For model_backend=tabular_sklearn: random_forest | hist_gradient_boosting | logistic_regression | xgboost.
tabular_model_type.title: Tabular Model Type

tabular_reuse_train_dataset.description: For model_backend=tabular_sklearn: when true and tabular_save_train_dataset is enabled, reuse a previously exported training dataset if its fingerprint matches current inputs.
tabular_reuse_train_dataset.title: Tabular Reuse Train Dataset

tabular_save_test_dataset.description: For model_backend=tabular_sklearn: when an explicit evaluation split is configured, export the assembled test/eval dataset.
tabular_save_test_dataset.title: Tabular Save Test Dataset

tabular_save_train_dataset.description: For model_backend=tabular_sklearn: if true, export the assembled training dataset (features + labels + sample_id) for reproducibility/auditing.
tabular_save_train_dataset.title: Tabular Save Train Dataset

tabular_test_dataset_path.description: Optional output file for exported tabular test/eval dataset. When omitted and tabular_save_test_dataset=true, defaults to the same directory as tabular_train_dataset_path with filename tabular_test_dataset.<ext> (or <model_bundle_dir>/tabular_test_dataset.parquet when train path is also omitted).
tabular_test_dataset_path.title: Tabular Test Dataset Path

tabular_train_dataset_path.description: Optional output file for exported tabular training dataset. When omitted and tabular_save_train_dataset=true, defaults to <model_bundle_dir>/tabular_train_dataset.parquet.
tabular_train_dataset_path.title: Tabular Train Dataset Path

train_fraction.description: Fraction of samples used for training per cohort (e.g. 0.8).

validation.description: Validation/Monte Carlo settings when embedded in a project as step_config.validation.
